title: Which Box Hides the Treasure?
youtube_title: 🎁 Which Box Hides the TREASURE? Can You Guess? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Three mystery boxes — only ONE hides the golden treasure! Can you guess the right one before the reveal? Watch till the end and see if you were RIGHT! 🏆✨ Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #MysteryBox #TreasureHunt #Kidify #FunForKids #PuzzleForKids

scenes.narration: One of these boxes hides a golden treasure — but which one IS it?!
scenes.visual_prompt: Bright, colorful cartoon-style scene. Three large gift boxes sit on a shiny stage under a spotlight. Box on the left is red with white polka dots, box in the middle is blue with yellow stars, box on the right is green with orange stripes. Dramatic sparkling light beams down from above. Camera slowly zooms in on the three boxes. Exciting, vibrant, playful kids' show aesthetic.

scenes.narration: Is it the red box? The blue box? Or the green box? Pick your favourite — fast!
scenes.visual_prompt: The three boxes are shown side by side, each one gently bouncing up and down in turn as it is named. Cartoon question marks float and spin around them. Bright confetti rains down in the background. Camera pans slowly left to right across all three boxes. Bold labels appear above each box: RED, BLUE, GREEN. Fun, energetic kids' show style.

scenes.narration: Okay okay — countdown time! Three… two… one!
scenes.visual_prompt: A giant cartoon countdown timer appears in the centre of the screen, numbers counting down from 3 to 1 in big bouncy animated digits. Each number is a different bright colour and wobbles playfully as it appears. The three boxes shake with excitement in the background. Stars and lightning bolts radiate outward with each number. Loud, energetic kids' show feel.

scenes.narration: Let's check the RED box first! The lid flies open and… it's a rubber chicken! Bock bock! Not the treasure!
scenes.visual_prompt: The red polka-dot box on the left springs open with a big cartoon POP effect. A goofy rubber chicken bursts out, wobbling and jiggling in the air with a silly wide-eyed expression and cartoon spring legs bouncing it around. Confetti and silly musical notes float out of the box. The chicken waves its wings comically. Big red X stamp appears on screen with a wobbly animation. Bright, funny, cartoonish kids' show style.

scenes.narration: Now the GREEN box! It pops open and… oh wow, it's a giant pile of spaghetti! That's NOT it either!
scenes.visual_prompt: The green striped box on the right bursts open with a cartoon explosion of colour. An enormous, wiggly, cartoonish pile of spaghetti erupts out, noodles flopping and swirling in every direction with silly googly eyes on the meatballs. Tomato sauce splashes comically in slow motion. A big green X stamp wobbles onto the screen. The spaghetti pile tips over sideways in a funny way. Bright, exaggerated, playful kids' cartoon aesthetic.

scenes.narration: That means… the BLUE box! Let's open it! The lid shoots off and — YES! It's the golden treasure! You got it!
scenes.visual_prompt: The blue star-covered box in the centre glows with a golden light. The lid dramatically launches upward in slow motion with a burst of sparkles and light rays. A dazzling golden treasure chest rises out of it, overflowing with sparkling gold coins, gems, and twinkling stars. Confetti and fireworks explode all around in the background. Camera zooms in slowly on the glowing treasure. Big green checkmark and a golden trophy icon appear on screen. Triumphant, celebratory kids' show atmosphere.

scenes.narration: Amazing! Did you pick blue? Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it's going to be even trickier!
scenes.visual_prompt: Bright celebratory end card screen with colourful balloons, stars, and confetti raining down. A cartoon speech bubble in the centre reads 'LEVEL 2 TOMORROW!' in bold bouncy letters. The three boxes from the game appear small in the corners of the screen, with the blue box highlighted and glowing. The background pulses with rainbow colours. Fun, energetic, kids' channel outro style with the Kidify channel branding space at the bottom.
